checks.label: Latest selection settles through a transition invocation
checks.expression: (async()=>{const until=async test=>{const end=Date.now()+1500;while(!test()){if(Date.now()>end)return false;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}return true;};const click=text=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent===text||b.getAttribute('aria-label')===text);if(!b)throw new Error('Missing button: '+text);ReactDOM.flushSync(()=>b.click());};const type=(input,value)=>ReactDOM.flushSync(()=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(input,value);input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));});const original=React.useTransition;let starts=0;React.useTransition=function(){const [pending,start]=original();return [pending,callback=>{starts+=1;return start(callback);}];};const results=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('li')].map(e=>e.textContent).join(',');try{click('Show a');if(!await until(()=>results()==='apple,apricot'&&document.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent==='Ready'))return false;const before=starts;click('Show b');click('Show all');if(!await until(()=>document.querySelector('[data-selected]')?.dataset.selected==='all'&&results()==='apple,apricot,berry'&&document.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent==='Ready'))return false;return starts>before;}finally{React.useTransition=original;click('Show a');click('Show all');await until(()=>results()==='apple,apricot,berry'&&document.querySelector('[role=status]')?.textContent==='Ready');}})()
